## Decision

<a id="CodesWeRaise"></a>

### The problems the service will not leave

`CodesWeRaise` · `src/judgment.ts:23` · published

A node nobody answers for, a requirement nobody can check, an architecture decision nothing applies: each would be a warning; the service makes it an error.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| codes | owner-missing, requirement-without-criteria, adr-not-applied |

- Decided by: karim
- Rejected: Every warning an error, a check awaited, a review awaited, an assumption to check are work in progress, not mistakes: the service would never ship; As the language says, a requirement without criteria would ship as a wish
- Used by: [Judged our way](#OurJudgment)
